title: Changed default mode to code
body:
This changes the sphinx default from math to code. This means that now when something is within `s then it will now be code instead of math. Now if someone wants to have math in their docs then they explicitly need to add :math: in front for the `. I have fixed the few cases where some math did not have the :math: in front, but most math already had that.

Closes #1905
author: mnygp
